items.author: cursorial
items.descZh: domybidding.lol 是一个以"悬赏注意力"为核心的众包表演市场，用户可以发布最低5美元的悬赏，招募陌生人在镜头前完成任务，资金池会持续累积直到表演者交付成果。平台采用三阶段流程（发布悬赏→表演者认领→三人现场监督核验），并对每笔悬赏提供二元完成度预测市场供用户交易赔率，目前累计已售出约420万美元的"注意力"，当前有1,269个活跃竞标。该平台最具争议的亮点在于其"受限"（Section 12）板块：84%的访客会主动查看那些要求表演者承受持续个人代价的列表，而92%的访客在平台提示"这些内容已被移除"后仍坚持继续浏览，系统会对每一次查看进行日志记录以满足18+年龄验证。设计上融合了合规审核（4天清关）、多签验证和预测市场机制，但明确通过条款免除对表演者福祉的责任。它本质上定位于一个充满黑色幽默与赛博朋克质感的"人类动物园"实验场景，典型用户是热衷于小众刺激、对博彩式交易机制熟悉、且能够接受灰色地带内容的加密社区与亚文化群体。

items.author: rosshaugh
items.descZh: Clink 是一个面向现代 C++(C++23) 的嵌入式流处理引擎，基于 Apache Arrow 原生数据格式，旨在弥合嵌入式单机执行与分布式集群部署之间的鸿沟。其核心功能是允许用户以 SQL 编写流式管道，既能在进程内以毫秒级延迟运行，也可将同一份文件直接提交到分布式集群执行。它具备生产级关键特性，包括 exactly-once 精确一次语义、基于事件时间的窗口处理、状态以开放的 Arrow 数据格式存储，以及支持确定性回放以保证可重放性与可调试性。该项目拥有 1,104 次提交和 2 个 Star，仓库结构完善，包含 benchmarks、fuzz 测试、Python 绑定、Docker 部署、CMake 构建及完整文档（mkdocs）。适用场景涵盖需要低延迟嵌入式流处理、或需要无缝横向扩展到分布式环境的金融交易、IoT 实时分析、ETL 流水线以及任何同时存在进程内与集群两种部署形态的 Arrow 生态用户。

items.title: Show HN: Contextual – local codebase memory for AI coding agents
items.desc: description: A localfirst AI context engine with semantic search, temporal recall, and ondevice indexing. title: Contextual — Your AI&x27;s memory. Localfirst, always. image: https://contextuallabs.dev/opengraphimage?f8ca76ce20e2c669 [Skip to content](maincontent) v1.0.0 — Beta Launch— Built for developers that think Your AI's memory. Localfirst, always. Temporal semantic search that remembers everything your AI forgets. A context engine that runs entirely on your machine — indexed, queryable, and aware of how your repository changed over time. [Install via uvx](install)[Read Docs](/docs) LocalSecureUniversal \~/projects/paymentsapi — contextual ⌘K $ uvx tool install contextualengine → resolving package · contextualengine@1.0.0 $ contextual index → spawning local index at \~/.contextual/paymentsapi ✓ indexed 12,847 symbols across 418 files ✓ embedded 31,204 chunks · model CodeRankEmbed / ondevice ✓ temporal graph synced through commit a91f0c2 An AI coding agent, connected over MCP — tool calls below, not typed by hand ▸ nexus\_search(query="why did we switch the webhook signer to HMACSHA512?", intent="mixed") 4 nodes · 2 structural hops · blame + live staleness attached: • commit b2e914a — "security: harden webhook verification" · 2024‑11‑08 • PR 482 — review thread, 14 comments, resolved • webhooks/signer.ts — diff hunk L41‑L78 · staleness fresh • RFC‑017.md — §3 "rotation cadence" ▸ answer assembled in 93.85ms · 0 tokens left the device ▸ decision\_create(title="Use HMACSHA512 for webhook signing", context="...", decision="...", consequences="...") { "adr\_id": "adr\_7f3a91c2", "status": "proposed" } ✓ embedded for decision\_search ↳ runtime · 1 package · 0.8GB ↳ memory · \~120MB resident ↳ network · 0 egress ↳ license · Proprietary § 02 — primitives Many primitives. One coherent memory. Contextual is engineered around the smallest set of ideas that make a codebase searchable through time, on a single laptop, without sending anything out. 01 Semantic Search Ask in plain English. Get back the exact function, commit, decision, or doc paragraph that matters — ranked by meaning, not keywords. $ contextual ask "where do we cap concurrent jobs?" match · 0.94 02 Temporal Queries Every symbol, comment and PR is anchored in time. Ask "what did this file mean last quarter?" and walk the answer backwards. JanAprJulOct 03 Code Graph Every function, commit, and doc is a node — calls, imports, and edits are edges. Trace impact outward or walk dependencies back, without grepping. $ contextual graph impact webhooks/signer.ts 14 callers · 3 files 04 Zero Cloud Embeddings, index, and graph live in \~/.contextual. Nothing is uploaded, nothing is logged, nothing leaves the device. Ever. 0 bytes egress 100% on‑device § 03 — architecture A pipeline that fits on one laptop, and behaves like infrastructure. on‑device pipeline · \~/.contextual 0 network calls CHUNKSHYBRID QUERYSTOREMCP SRC your repo git log · working files INDEX on‑device index LanceDB · CodeRankEmbed GRAPH temporal graph calls, imports · git blame \~/.contextual single local store RECALL context server hybrid search · MCP CLIENT your editor, your agent Cursor · Claude Code · Claude Desktop · VS Code · + more SRC your repo git log · working files INDEX on‑device index LanceDB · CodeRankEmbed GRAPH temporal graph calls, imports · git blame STORE \~/.contextual single local store · hybrid query RECALL context server hybrid search · MCP MCP CLIENT your editor, your agent Cursor · Claude Code · Claude Desktop · VS Code · + more fs watcher keeps INDEX + GRAPH current — reindexes on save, forks the graph on branch 01 Contextualised in seconds, watched forever A filesystem watcher keeps the graph honest. Rename a function, the recall updates. Drop a branch, the timeline forks. 02 Speaks MCP natively Plugs into Cursor, Claude Desktop, VS Code, and any agent that speaks Model Context Protocol — without bespoke glue. 03 Reversible by design One folder, one binary. rm rf \~/.contextual and it's like it never happened. 04 Deeper than search, out of the box Blast‑radius impact analysis, undeclared‑coupling detection, blame‑enriched history, architectural decision records — 22 tools across five classes, all on the same MCP connection. 5min to contextualize · 50k LOC 0.8gb single static package 0bytes of your code sent to a server 93.85ms median recall latency § 04 — install One line. No dependencies you'll regret. Contextual ships as a single static binary, runnable through uvx or any Python 3.11 environment. macOS, Linux, and Windows — Apple Silicon included. macOS · arm64 / x86\_64Linux · glibc 2.31+Windows · WSL2 uvxpipx $ uvx tool install contextualengine $ cd ~/yourproject $ contextual init → ready in 0.34s Verified: sha256 · 9f3a…c12d Copy § 05 — principles Opinionated about the things that matter. Local before clever P/01 If a feature can't run offline on a 2019 MacBook Air, it doesn't ship. Cleverness that depends on a server is just rent. Time is a first‑class column P/02 A codebase isn't a snapshot — it's a stream of decisions. Contextual treats every fact as something with a birthday and, sometimes, a death. No magic, plain files P/03 Indexes are SQLite. Embeddings are flat files. You can open them, diff them, and back them up the same way you back up everything else. The agent is a guest P/04 Your AI is allowed to read what you allow, and it's audited when it does. Context is granted, not assumed. Transparency over accuracy P/05 A confidentsounding answer with no source is a guess in a suit. Every result carries the commit, PR, or file it came from, so you can verify it yourself. Universally agnostic P/06 No favorite language, framework, or editor. Contextual indexes whatever your repo actually contains and speaks MCP to whatever's asking — Cursor, Claude, VS Code, or the next thing. MODEL WATCH Context windows balloon past a million tokens, still not enough Engineers report diminishing returns as prompts grow longer than the problems they descr
items.author: aarjunm04
items.descZh: Contextual 是一款定位"AI 长期记忆"的本地优先上下文引擎，主打语义搜索、时间轴回溯与代码图谱分析，所有索引、嵌入和图谱数据均存储在本地 ~/.contextual 目录，绝不上传云端。其核心能力包括：用自然语言跨提交、PR、文档做混合检索（hybrid search），追踪符号随时间演化的状态，并自动产出架构决策记录（ADR）；通过 Model Context Protocol（MCP）原生接入 Cursor、Claude Desktop/Code、VS Code 等 AI 代理，开箱即用 22 个工具覆盖影响域分析、隐性耦合检测、blame 增强历史等场景。官方基准显示其能在约 5 分钟内索引 5 万行代码，封装为约 0.8 GB 的单文件静态二进制，运行时内存约 120 MB，中位召回延迟 93.85 ms，且全程零出站流量。它特别适合处理大型遗留代码库、频繁重构的多人协作项目，以及对数据合规敏感的企业研发环境——开发者既能让 AI 理解"为什么这么写"，又无需担心源码离开本机。

items.title: Show HN: Flint
items.desc: description: Flint is a selfhosted neural network that reads live market data, forecasts the next hour for a basket of stocks, and shows its reasoning as it goes. Runs on your machine; your keys stay with you. title: Flint selfhosted · continuously learning A market model that keeps learning. Flint is a selfhosted neural network that reads live market data, forecasts the next hour for a basket of stocks, and shows its reasoning as it goes. A local model even writes the daily brief. It runs on your machine and your keys stay with you. [Get started](quickstart) [View on GitHub](https://github.com/thinggco/flint) Python · PyTorch · FastAPI · a nobuild dashboard · optional local LLM via Ollama the live dashboard — candles, MACD, a forecast fan, and cards that reorder by urgency What it does A forecasting model, a trading dashboard, and a window into the model's head, in one thing you run yourself. 🧠 Always learning It trains online as its forecasts mature, and its calibration keeps it honest. When it has no real edge it holds, instead of trading noise. 📈 Live charts Every stock gets a candlestick chart with MACD and a forecast fan. Cards rank by urgency and reorder in real time, and any chart flips between 5 and 1 minute bars. 🔦 See it think A control panel streams the model's consciousness across eight consoles, and a Console tab tails everything at once: the feed, the features, the forecasts, the policy, the training. 📝 Ondevice brief Small models summarize the tape, the macro backdrop, positioning and the smart money. A larger local model turns those notes into a plain newspaper column. It all runs through Ollama, so nothing leaves the machine. 🏛️ Investor council A panel of wellknown investors, built from their real 13F filings and documented style, nudges the model. Burry, Buffett, Ackman, Icahn and others. 🛰️ Wholemarket radar Breadth, sector rotation, volatility and a large movers watchlist give you and the model the full picture. Penny and smallcap movers included. 🔒 Local and private Everything runs on your machine. API keys sit in gitignored files and only ever talk to their own provider. ⚙️ Fits your machine A firstrun benchmark sizes the network to your hardware and uses the GPU when there is one, so it runs on a laptop or a workstation. How it works It behaves less like a backtest and more like a trader who shows up every morning and keeps score. Warm up flint pulls intraday history, benchmarks your machine, and trains on the recent session before it goes live. Stream and forecast Real trades drive the charts. Each bar the model forecasts the next hour and turns it into a buy, sell or hold with a reason in plain English. Learn as it goes An hour later every forecast is scored and the model recalibrates. You judge it on live accuracy over hours, not on how well it fit the past. Each card shows the forecast, the band, and why the call is a buy, sell or hold. The Console tab tails every channel the model runs through, live. Run it You need Python 3.12 and [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/). For the written brief, install [Ollama](https://ollama.com/download) and pull a model. clone and install git clone git@github.com:thinggco/flint.git cd flint uv sync run it, then open http://localhost:8000 uv run flint optional: a local model for the daily brief ollama pull qwen3.5 or any chat model you like It works out of the box on free, nokey data sources. On first launch a short walkthrough lets you add API keys for better feeds, and you can skip any of them. Everything, including the LLM brief, runs locally. A word of caution. flint is for research and learning. Its forecasts are the output of a model that is often wrong, and it makes no guarantees. Nothing here is financial advice. Trading is risky and you can lose money.

items.author: 52h316g
items.descZh: 背景：YASS（Yet Another Stock Screener）是一款面向量化投资者的开源股票筛选与回测工具，由开发者 jamesjxliao 在 GitHub 上发布，旨在解决基本面选股时常见的"前视偏差"和回测过拟合问题。核心功能：工具支持基于 YAML 配置自定义信号权重与筛选条件，利用 Point-in-Time 历史数据进行回测（避免前视偏差），并通过蒙特卡洛模拟、因子归因和制度分析（regime analysis）等手段对策略进行稳健性评估；同时提供 CLI 命令行界面，可直接输出 top N 选股结果或对接 Alpaca、eToro 等券商进行实盘交易。亮点：采用 Sharadar 这样的机构级数据源并结合 DuckDB 本地缓存以提升性能，回测示例覆盖 2017–2026 年共 108 个月度收益，扣除 10 bps 往返成本后夏普比率的 90% 置信区间为 [0.37, 1.38]（基于 stationary block bootstrap 方法），项目内置 7 个示例信号且支持无 API key 时的 mock 数据回退，78 次提交体现了持续迭代的活跃度。适用场景：特别适合量化研究者、独立交易者以及金融科技开发者用于快速验证多因子选股策略、研究历史收益分布与风险敞口、或作为构建自动化投资管道的起点。
